risks.title: Credit risk and unexpected loan losses
risks.score_rationale: Explicitly mentioned as a key factor specific to HSBC ("incidence of loan losses or delinquency"). Moderate language but acknowledges inability to predict losses. Permanent structural risk for a universal bank. High weight in the business model.

risks.title: Regulatory compliance and compliance costs
risks.score_rationale: Explicitly cited: "costs, effects and outcomes of regulatory reviews, actions or litigation, including any additional compliance requirements". High uncertainty language. Trend of increasing global regulatory requirements. Major direct and indirect financial impact.

risks.title: Cybersecurity and integrity of critical data
risks.score_rationale: Explicit risk: "threats from cyber-attacks, which may impact our ability to service clients and may result in financial loss, business disruption and/or loss of customer services and data". Severe impact language. Growing trend in threats. Critical for operational continuity.

risks.title: Dependence on risk models and methodological limitations
risks.score_rationale: HSBC-specific risk: "model limitations or failure" and "model risk". Language explicitly acknowledges weaknesses. Trend increasing due to inflationary pressures affecting model performance. Indirect impact on capital and risk decisions.

risks.title: Fraud, financial crime and operational risks
risks.score_rationale: Explicitly cited: "third-party, fraud, financial crime and reputational risks" and "employee misconduct, which may result in regulatory sanctions". Language indicates financial and reputational impact. Permanent structural risk. High weight in global operations.

risks.title: Geopolitical tensions and commercial sanction risks
risks.score_rationale: Major explicitly detailed risk: "Russia-Ukraine war, further conflict or military action in the Middle East" and "diplomatic tensions between China and the US". Language indicates material impact on operations. Trend upward. Directly affects key markets (Hong Kong, China, UK).

risks.title: ESG risks and reputational greenwashing
risks.score_rationale: Explicit emerging risk: "increase the risk of greenwashing" and inability to meet ESG ambitions. Language acknowledges methodological and data challenges. Trend of rising regulatory expectations. Growing reputational impact.

risks.title: Increased competition from fintech and non-banking services
risks.score_rationale: Explicit risk: "increased competition from non-bank financial services companies". Moderate language but acknowledges structural threat. Trend upward. Impact on margins and market share.

ai_positioning.summary: HSBC is gradually adopting artificial intelligence in limited use cases such as compliance and risk management, without an offensive positioning as a technology leader.
evidence: Use of AI for fraud detection
No mention of major investments or a comprehensive AI strategy in the 20-F
